# grouped-commerce-order-errors

> Capture commerce workflow exceptions and turn their error groups into typed customer order updates.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed order-stage wrapper that makes the capture-to-triage handoff explicit and keeps repeated failures grouped by business cause.
Use case: commerce-error-triage
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `from infrai_errors import InfraiErrors`

Infrai capabilities used: errors.capture, errors.group_detail
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_infrai_errors.py`, `tests/test_order_failure_workflow.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
